title: CVP-HDDQN: Research software for hierarchical reinforcement learning in gold futures
description: Source-only research software for hierarchical reinforcement learning in gold futures. Includes the original installable neural, feature, learner and execution-ledger core, selected historical Python implementation/test sources, synthetic interface checks and software documentation. No financial outcomes, result tables, generated figures, raw market records, trained weights or original Git history are distributed. Historical training/replay entry points require external data and bound research contracts that are not supplied. Code: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Project documentation: CC BY-NC 4.0. Commercial use is not licensed.
